item.description:
## What’s new
- Fixes daily analysis drafts that contain a malformed client or project ID when the displayed client and project names uniquely identify the correct Beacon records. - Shows a warning whenever Beacon safely corrects those IDs before presenting the recommendation. - Continues to reject ambiguous matches or IDs that point to a different real record.
After updating, choose **Analyze day** again for any day that previously showed the catalog-validation error.

## What’s new
- Adds signed automatic updates, so Beacon only needs to be installed manually once. - Adds the finance-only AP/AR workspace with access to Cash Flow and Reports. - Applies role-based navigation and permissions for owner and AP/AR accounts. - Includes the latest company, contact, project, time-log, and QuickBooks workflow improvements.
Beacon checks for updates every six hours and installs downloaded updates after the app quits.
